sections.lead: Scalable Security Operations Center (SOC) Protect Today. Evolve Tomorrow. sections.title: What Victrix's SEvOC Has to Offer
paragraphs: Continuous monitoring, accelerated incident response, and enhanced cybersecurity. 24/7, bilingual SOC service with experts dedicated to your environment.
Accelerate your cybersecurity and optimize all your security tools. Unlike a traditional SOC, our scalable, modular offering keeps you at the forefront of security technologies.
➜ Deal with the increase in advanced cyber threats (ransomware, targeted attacks, attacks undetected by conventional approaches)
➜ Supplement your in-house security team with our experts to ensure the evolution and maintenance of your tools (EDR, SIEM, CSPM)
➜ Simplify the integration of your new entities in a context of growth or merger
➜ Achieve your strategic objectives while ensuring cybersecurity

sections.title: Services Beyond Traditional Managed Security
paragraphs: Victrix is not just a managed services provider. SEvOC is not just another SOC. Here’s what makes our SOC team so strong.

• Microsoft Sentinel Partnership — +30 active customers. • CrowdStrike ELP Partnership — +20,000 managed endpoints, only authorized French-speaking managed security service provider (MSSP). • We hold ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 certification — information security backed by international best practices. • Management of hybrid or complex environments.

• 100% locally operated, non-outsourced monitoring, with direct interaction between your internal teams and our security analysts assigned to your environment. • Customized reports, monitoring committees, and advice based on your environment's configuration — 90% of our customers adapt their configuration based on SEvOC recommendations.

• Continuous evolution of the security posture: definition and updating guidelines, configuration review, maturity coaching. • Access to the full depth of Victrix: direct support from our specialized infrastructure, cloud, governance, and network teams, with no external outsourcing.
